fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Fires 5 rounds in a wide spread; each round deals 6 damage and knocks the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Hull Piercer
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy ball that deals 40 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Steady Keel
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
